entries.question: Some kinds of bats ______ insects, which helps farmers with pest control.
entries.concept: feed on ＝ 以……為食（主詞是吃的一方）。
steps: 蝙蝠吃昆蟲 → bats feed on insects。
feed A with B 是「用 B 餵 A」，主詞是餵食者。

entries.question: At a time ______ there were all-powerful gods in the universe, Prometheus created humans.
entries.concept: 先行詞是「時間」，關係副詞用 when（＝ in which）。
steps: 空格後是完整句子 there were all-powerful gods...，不缺主詞或受詞，要用關係副詞。
pitfalls: 選 which：which 後面的子句要缺主詞或受詞。
